method: fetch counts wrap HTTPFileSystem._cat_file, so they are exact and independent of link speed; failed fetches raise and are not counted

runs.note: amplification = chunk fetches / distinct chunks. 1.0 means every chunk was fetched exactly once. Counting wraps HTTPFileSystem._cat_file, so it is outside any cache: a cache hit is an absent request, not a cheap one.
